Momonosuke faces Kaido once again trembling in fear. However, with Luffy’s encouragement, he bravely steps up and shows his dragon fangs remembering what he had to go through because of Kaido.
A Legend All Over Again! Luffy`s Fist Roars in the Sky

Yamato helps Momonosuke conquer his fear of flying and the two take on the most important task of saving Onigashima. Meanwhile, Luffy and Kaidou clash which parts the heavens. The clear skies help Inuarashi and Nekomamushi finally defeat their foes.
The Situation Has Grown Tense! The End of Onigashima!
Realizing Onigashima’s impending threat, imperiling everyone’s life, Yamato and Momonosuke launch a secret operation. Meanwhile, Sanji and Zoro are both in a deadly battle against Queen and King.
Sanji`s Mutation - The Two Arms in Crisis!

Queen’s unforeseen move stuns everyone on the Performance Floor. And then, he goes on to utilize another special technique which can break every bone in Sanji’s body. On the verge of a crisis, Sanji feels something strange again.
Death to Your Partner! Killer`s Deadly Gamble

Killer tries to figure out how to fight against Hawkins whose power enables him to transfer damage against him to Kid. Kid is dying not knowing where his damage is coming from. Killer takes a chance with Kid’s life on the line.
A Shadowy Figure Pulls the Strings! Onigashima in Flames

Sanji still wonders what is happening to his body as he receives attacks. Meanwhile, the dying Kin’emon hears an unexpected voice calling for the also dying Kanjuro. Through the Smail, the voice of Orochi tries to stir up Kanjuro to make him perform one last time.
A Countercharge! Law and Kid`s Return-Attack Combination

Law and Kid are having a tough battle against a formidable Emperor of the Sea, Big Mom. However, when they decide to work collaboratively and use their awakened Devil Fruit powers, they see the possibility of taking down the old generation.
For Luffy - Sanji and Zoro`s Oath

Sanji is tormented by the idea of becoming a cruel Germa warrior like his siblings and torn between being strong or being humane as he is now. When he makes up his mind, he asks Zoro the ultimate favor.
The Onslaught of Kazenbo - Orochi`s Evil Clutches Close In

The Fiery Monk, materialization of the destructive ire of the Kurozumi clan, continues his deadly descent into the castle and instills fear in both the ranks of Kaido's pirates and those of the samurai. Orochi, all excited by the scenes of panic, suddenly hears a sound that brings back happy memories.
Zoro Faces Adversity - A Monster! King the Wildfire

Zoro is facing a hard fight against King who seems invincible. Even one of Zoro’s deadliest attacks doesn’t leave a scratch on him. On top of that, one of Zoro’s swords goes out of control and gets in his way.
The Secret of Enma! The Cursed Sword Entrusted to Zoro
Zoro still can’t gain control of Enma which keeps extracting his Haki. Backed into a corner by the formidable King, Zoro remembers the encounter with an old man in his hometown when he was a child.
The Strike of an Ifrit! Sanji vs. Queen

Queen’s formidable attacks remind Sanji of his family. Annoyed by Queen’s provocations, Sanji remembers a young woman mysteriously getting hurt in front of him and realizes what happened at that time, which lights a fire within him.
The Three-Sword Style of the Supreme King! Zoro vs. King

Zoro tries to figure out a way to damage King. Meanwhile, King remembers when he first met his captain Kaido and declares that his captain is the one to become the King of the Pirates, which leads Zoro to set his swords alight with hellfire.
Luffy Is on the Move! A Turning Point to a New Era!

Usopp finds Kin’emon’s upper body and the heavily wounded Kiku. However, they are surrounded by the Gifters and can’t find a way out. Seeing the samurai giving up hope, Usopp remembers his determination.
Drunken Dragon Bagua! The Lawless Dragon Closing in on Luffy

In the Flower Capital, the Fire Festival is about to end. On Onigashima, the battle between Luffy and Kaido is getting even more intense. However, Kaido who is excited about having a strong opponent starts drinking too much.
The Destruction of the Alliance?! Fire Up, the Will of the New Generation!

Determined to counter the fury of Big Mom, who is about to join Kaido, Kidd and Law must face the imperial omnipotence while in the underground arsenal, Yamato leads the assault against the fiery monk. As the death knell tolls for the final battles, will the rebellion emerge victorious?
Here Comes the Main Act! Powerful Techniques of Shockwave and Magnetism
Big Mom’s strong life force discourages Law and Kid. Law tells Kid that he only has enough energy for one last strike. However, a monster Big Mom summons puts the two in even more of a bind.
To the New Era! Settled! The Determination of the Brats
Kid’s all-out deadly attack and Law’s tactical action leave Big Mom in the lurch. Then she remembers what Roger said in the past and wonders if the treasure he mentioned is out there after all.
Moon Princess Echoes! The Final Phase of the Land of Wano!

Kaido mourns Big Mom’s defeat and remembers the day he met her for the first time. Meanwhile, backed into a corner, Orochi sees the true nature of Komurasaki, the woman he loves, and trembles with fear.
There Is Only One Winner - Luffy vs. Kaido

On orders from the Five Elders, the CP-0 agent Guernica tries to get to Luffy, but Drake stands in his way. Meanwhile, Luffy who only has very little energy left uses his last Gear Four to emancipate the people of the Land of Wano from Kaido.
Luffy Is Defeated?! The Determination of Those Left Behind

The main battle of the dome ends unexpectedly. Running out of a serious fight, a furious Kaido confronts the injured samurai. Now that 20 years of hope have crumbled before his eyes, can they find a way out of hell?

As Luffy’s heart pounds in a funny way, the Five Elders reveal the secret behind the Gum-Gum Fruit. Meanwhile, Orochi tries to convince Komurasaki to escape with him, but when he sees Kanjuro, he makes a malicious decision.
The Ridiculous Power! Gear Five in Full Play
With his newfound power, Luffy is able to overwhelm Kaidou to the point where he greatly enjoys the battle, shocking Kaidou and his allies alike with his immense power.
No Way Out! A Hellish Scene on Onigashima

As Luffy and Kaidou continue their battle, Raizo and Jinbe utilize their plan to put out the fire that has spread throughout Onigashima. Meanwhile, Yamato warns Momonosuke of the danger Onigashima will face if he does not act soon to create new flame clouds to keep it from crashing into the Flower Capital.
I Trust Momo - Luffy`s Final Powerful Technique!

As Momonosuke struggles to create his own flame clouds, Luffy continues to fight Kaidou. As the Samurai realize what would happen to Onigashima if Luffy won, Orochi is freed from the Seastone Nail and attempts to murder Hiyori. After hearing the voices of the people, Luffy prepares his final attack.
20 Years` Worth of Prayers! Take Back the Land of Wano

As Momonosuke is doubting he could move Onigashima out of the way of Luffy's final attack, both he and Kaidou prepare their final strike. As the cruelty of the past twenty years on Wano Country is shown, the alliance prays for Luffy's victory. As Denjiro saves Hiyori from Orochi, the people at the Fire Festival reveal their true wish with their Sky Lanterns.

Kaido remembers how he was treated unfairly in the past and how he believes the world should be. While his friends struggle to survive on Onigashima, Luffy is asked by Kaido to picture his ideal world as he throws a destructive punch.
The Curtain Falls! The Winner, Straw Hat Luffy!

The samurai and the Straw Hats shout for joy as they hear that Luffy defeated Kaido. Meanwhile, Momonosuke informs Zunesha of a major decision that he made. However, when Yamato calls on the Animal Kingdom Pirates to stop fighting, the earth trembles.
He Returns! The Shogun of the Land of Wano, Kozuki Momonosuke

The people of the Flower Capital get flustered when Kin’emon and the other Akazaya samurai who were supposed to be dead appear from the smoke. However, the last one who walks out of the smoke, and what he says, confuses the people even more.
The Morning Comes! Luffy and the Others Rest!

The Land of Wano is in a celebratory mood now that the years of tyranny are over. However, Yamato is holding back his hunger alone until Hiyori arrives with the news he was waiting for. Meanwhile, some unknown figure approaches the Land of Wano.
A Celebration Banquet! The New Emperors of the Sea!
Tenguyama reveals his true identity as Sukiyaki to Robin and confirms Wano's secret. The new Emperors of the Sea are declared, as Ryokugyu heads after Luffy.
The World Will Burn! The Onslaught of a Navy Admiral!

As the Navy Admiral Ryokugyu comes to strike the Flower Capital, the Akazaya samurai notice and try to stop him, but his Woods-Woods Fruit power overwhelms them. Meanwhile, another formidable, yet friendly, guest approaches the Land of Wano
The Coming of the New Era! The Red-Haired`s Imperial Rage

Sukiyaki shows Robin and Law the Road Ponyglyph and tells them more about Wano's history. Momonosuke decides to face Ryokugyu to prove he could defend Wano and successfully uses the Bolo Breath attack. Shanks releases a tremendous burst of Haoshoku Haki to force the admiral to retreat.
The World That Moves On! A New Organization, Cross Guild

The party is over, and at the castle in the capital of flowers, Kinemon and Kiku are worried about Raizo and Shinobu, who have become thinner due to the battle with the Midori Cow. Meanwhile, Momonosuke and Hiyori come to know Hitetsu's true identity.
Time to Depart - The Land of Wano and the Straw Hats

An untold story from before the Straw Hats’ departure. Luffy visits the ruins of Oden Castle where Oden’s grave once was and Zoro visits Yasuie’s grave where he meets Hiyori. Later, Luffy and Tama eat red-bean soup together for the last time and share their feelings with each other.
The Last Curtain! Luffy and Momonosuke`s Vow
Angered by Luffy's attempt to leave without saying goodbye, Momonosuke rushes with Kin’emon and Yamato to the port from where the Straw Hats are about to leave, thinking back on his days with Luffy.
A New Emperor! Buggy the Genius Jester!

Luffy and the other Straw Hats’ new bounties are revealed. Meanwhile, at Emptee Bluffs Island, Crocodile and the greatest swordsman in the world Mihawk, visit Buggy to discuss their newly-established organization, Cross Guild.
The War on the Island of Women! A Case Involving Koby the Hero
Navy Captain Koby comes to the Island of Women to arrest Pirate Empress Hancock with the new Pacifistas. While the Navy and Kuja fighters clash, Blackbeard comes to raid, also targeting　Hancock.

The three-way struggle between the Navy, the Blackbeard Pirates, and the Kuja Pirates comes to an end when an unexpected figure shows up. On the Sunny, the Straw Hats talk about the recent incidents around the world and Luffy’s words surprise everyone.
Entering a New Chapter! Luffy and Sabo`s Paths!

The World Government destroys Lulusia Kingdom before Sabo could divulge information about Imu over the Den Den Mushi. Several days later, the Straw Hat Pirates come across a young girl trapped in a Warm Eddy.
A New Island! Future Island Egghead

Luffy and Chopper fall into the rough cold sea along with the mysterious girl. Jimbei tries to help them but another attack comes from the unknown creature. Meanwhile, the Sunny is hit by torpedoes and the rest of the Straw Hats are thrown into the sea, too.
Brimming with the Future! An Adventure on the Island of Science!

A young girl who came out of the big robot names herself Dr. Vegapunk and it surprises Franky and the rest of the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Luffy’s group gets to the surface of the island where futuristic buildings stand and unknown giant creatures wander about.
Bonney`s Lamentation! Darkness Lurking on the Future Island

While Luffy and the others are enjoying the futuristic machines of Egghead, someone who resembles Bartholomew Kuma comes after them. When Luffy tries to fight back, Bonney stops him and reveals her shocking relationship with Kuma.
The Winner Takes All! Law vs. Blackbeard!

The Blackbeard Pirates ambushed the Heart Pirates led by Law. The Blackbeard Pirates’ top officers use a variety of formidable Devil Fruit powers and keep pushing the Heart Pirates in order to obtain the copies of the Road Ponegliffs.

Bonney changes the ages of Luffy, Chopper, Jinbe, and hers, so that the Pacifista won't recognize them. Meanwhile, Lilith gives the rest of the crew a tour, and they respond enthusiastically, until someone who looks like Jinbe show up.
The Brain of a Genius - Six Vegapunks!

Science offers endless possibilities! Research has already begun! An inscrutable quest for knowledge that confuses the straw hats. Good and evil. Wisdom and greed. Reason and instinct. Talented minds that come from all directions and are now reunited!
A Forbidden Piece of History! A Theory Concerning a Kingdom

Vegapunk Shaka shares with Robin and the others his theory about an ancient kingdom and the 100-Year Void. He even says that he visited Ohara after its destruction. Meanwhile, Luffy and Chopper try to activate the giant robot and something surprising happens.
The Will of Ohara! The Inherited Research

Shaka reveals the secret behind the foundation of the Revolutionary Army and how the relationship between Vegapunk and Dragon affected it. Meanwhile, Vegapunk explains to Luffy and the others about his special power and how his clones work. The wish for the future conveyed by the Ohara scholars moves the Straw Hats.
The Eccentric Dream of a Genius!
The scientific power of 900 years ago is revealed in front of the iron giant. Vegapunk is fascinated by the energy of an antique and brims with ideas and ideals. What awaits the future you dream of?
Preparations for Interception! Rob Lucci Strikes!

CP-0 led by Rob Lucci makes a forced landing at Egghead and people on the Fabriophase are plunged into confusion while Shaka and the others prepare to fight back on the Labophase. The enraged Atlas stands up to defend the peace of the island.
Powers on a Different Level! Luffy vs. Lucci!

Luffy transforms into the Warrior of Liberation as Rob Lucci also shows his awakened Devil Fruit form. As the two clash, Vegapunk reveals the shocking truth of the Gum-Gum Fruit and his eye-opening theory on Devil Fruits.
The Strongest Form of Humanity! The Seraphim`s Powers!

Vegapunk describes how he managed to grant the Seraphim Devil Fruit powers, which surprises Franky and the others. Meanwhile, Luffy is still facing Lucci in his savage, awakened form, but the rocket to the Labophase is about to leave.
Sinister Schemes! The Operation to Escape Egghead

Vegapunk asks the Straw Hats to take him on board their ship which makes Franky and Usopp happy but annoys Nami. Lucci orders his troops to block off all Vegapunk’s escape routes and looks to invade the heavily-secured Labophase.
Turn Back My Father! Bonney`s Futile Wish!

CP-0 enters the Labophase and starts attacking the Thousand Sunny as soon as they find it. Luffy reunites with Nami and the others but finds out that Vegapunk is missing. Meanwhile, Bonney is pressing Vegapunk to change back her father Kuma.
A Desperate Situation! The Seraphim`s All-out Attack!

The Seraphim come following CP-0 to the Labophase, pitting Zoro and Brook against the seven of them. Sanji, Franky, Edison, and Lilith leave the lab to fight them, but the Seraphim launch a full-scale attack on the lab.
A Beautiful Act of Treason! The Spy, Stussy!
Stussy shows her intentions and attacks Lucci. Her unexpected smile confuses the Straw Hats. As the Seraphim continue to attack, the true objective of the mysterious Stussy is revealed.

About to escape from Egghead, Dr. Vegapunk, key to the mission, suddenly and inexplicably disappears. Where could he have gone if the lab was closed? The Straw Hat crew starts searching for the genius scientist.
A Shudder! The Evil Hand Creeping Up on the Laboratory
Bonney witnesses her father Bartholomew Kuma’s painful memories. Meanwhile at the lab, Shaka notices that their communications and surveillance cameras are being cut off by somebody.

The Seraphim suddenly attack the Straw Hats. They even ignore orders from the satellites. Who is giving them commands? While suspicion falls on Vegapunk's satellites, the Seraphim's attacks corner Luffy and his crew.
A Tough Decision! An Unusual United Front!

Lucci and Kaku from CP-0, who came to Egghead with a mission to eliminate the seven Vegapunks, ask Luffy and Zoro to uncuff them so they can fight alongside them against the Seraphim, but Luffy and Zoro are reluctant to do so.
Survive! Deadly Combat with the Strongest Form of Humanity!

Zoro realizes that the Seraphim have King's Lunarian abilities. Sanji arrives to help Nami and Brook against S-Shark, and S-Snake partially turns Franky to stone while completely petrifying Usopp and Lilith. Meanwhile, Shaka tracks down Dr. Vegapunk while following a lead, only to be killed by a mysterious assassin.
The Second Ohara! The Mastermind`s Ambition!

Stussy and Sentomaru discuss how big the threat that closes in on Egghead is as Luffy and the others keep fighting the uncontrollable Seraphim. Meanwhile, in an underground lab, someone approaches Vegapunk, who is being held captive.

Kid gives his crew a pep talk before the battle with Shanks. And Shanks also prepares for the battle but learns how his own subordinates do as they like to protect their beloved boss. Finally, Kid has his Damned Punk ready to shoot.
Run, Koby! A Desperate Escape Strategy!

Held at the Pirate Island of Beehive, Koby gets a chance to be free but decides to become a decoy to liberate slaves on the island. Pirates from all over the island come after him because of the big bounty on his head.
For the Beloved Pupil - The Fist of Vice Admiral Garp!

A huge warship comes flying towards the pirate island of Hachinosu, and Vice Admiral Garp launches a devastating attack to rescue his student Corby. Corby almost reaches the ship while Frigate Captain Hibari runs alongside him.
The Navy Surprised! The Navy Headquarters` Former Admiral, Kuzan

Kuzan faces Garp, who has come to rescue Koby. 
Why did he join Blackbeard after leaving the Navy? Once Garp's prized student, Kuzan is now a pirate, challenging his former mentor
Let`s Go Get It! Buggy`s Big Declaration

Sengoku, the former Admiral of the Fleet, and Great Adviser Tsuru discuss the murder of Vice Admiral T-Bone and concerns about Cross Guild. Meanwhile, Buggy gives a passionate speech to Crocodile, Mihawk, and his crew.
Sabo Returns - The Shocking Truth to Be Told!

Sabo returns to Kamabakka Queendom and starts recounting what happened at the Holy Land Mary Geoise. A month ago, during the Reverie, he and the captains of the Revolutionary Army raided the Land of Gods and Sabo witnessed Bartholomew Kuma being the Celestial Dragons’ slave.
The Holy Land in Tumult! Sai and Leo`s Full-Power Blow!

In the Holy Land Mary Geoise during the Reverie, Sabo runs into Bartholomew Kuma’s daughter Bonney. Meanwhile, King Cobra of the Kingdom of Alabasta begins asking the Five Elders questions that trouble them.
The Entrusted Message! King Cobra`s Resolve

King Cobra is surprised by seeing someone sitting on the Empty Throne and by learning about the truth of the world. When he is subject to a deadly attack, Sabo cuts in to save him. The injured king entrusts Sabo with a message.
The World Is Shaken! The Ruler`s Judgment and the Five Elders` Actions!

Sabo, Vivi and Wapol, as well as Bonney all escape from Mary Geoise by stowing away on different ships. Imu decides to test the Mother Flame on Lulusia Kingdom. Sabo finishes his story with what happened at Lulusia Kingdom when it was destroyed. Ivankov suspects that the Imu Sabo met might be one of the First Twenty. Meanwhile at Mary Geoise, Mjosgard is executed by Garling for his earlier actions of defending Otohime's family.
Garp and Kuzan - A Master and a Pupil`s Beliefs Clash

At the Pirate Island of Beehive, Vice Admiral Garp, who came to rescue the kidnapped Koby, deals with an overwhelming number of pirates alone. As he and his fellow Navy soldiers try to escape the island, Kuzan, the former Navy admiral, stands in their way.

Avalo Pizarro, who merged with the Pirate Island, reaches his giant hand to crush the Navy ship with many soldiers and civilians on board. The wounded Garp gives orders to Koby, Helmeppo, and Prince Grus, and delivers a powerful blow to save the ship.
The World Shakes! The Straw Hats` Hostage Situation

As the news spreads throughout the world of Garp's disappearance and the hostage situation regarding Dr. Vegapunk, the repercussions of Lulusia Kingdom's destruction affects the entire world. As Admiral Kizaru's forces surround Egghead, York contacts them to reveal she had been caught by the Straw Hat Pirates.
Completely Surrounded! The Operation to Escape Egghead

In the Labophase on Egghead, which is completely surrounded by the Navy, Luffy and the others devise a plan to escape the island. However, the Frontier Dome, the laser defense system, cannot be deactivated without York’s secret passcode.
A Clash of Two Men`s Determination! Kizaru and Sentomaru

Navy Admiral Kizaru finally makes landfall on Egghead and Sentomaru, Vegapunk’s bodyguard, stands in his way. The two men who were once close now clash violently. Meanwhile, Luffy and the others try their best to move the Sunny to the back side of the island to escape.
Looming Despair! Admiral Kizaru`s Depressing Mission

Kuma finally reaches Mary Geoise and keeps advancing even without free will or mind. But Fleet Admiral Akainu stands in his way. On Egghead, Kizaru enters the Labophase and delivers a powerful kick to Luffy who tries to stop him.
Luffy vs. Kizaru! A Fierce Kaleidoscopic Battle

A bizarre battle between Luffy and Kizaru heats up. Meanwhile, in the Fabiriophase, Bonney is all alone and being chased by the Navy soldiers. Dr. Vegapunk sees this and can’t help but leave the Labophase to rescue her, risking his life.
The Nightmare Strikes - Godhead of Science & Defense, St. Saturn

Vegapunk successfully wrests back the Pacifistas from the Navy, but another party soon gains control of them. At the same time, Luffy, Zoro, and the others sense an unearthly presence just as a pentagram suddenly appears on Egghead.
Kuma`s Past - Better Off Dead in This World

Bonney gets captured by St. Saturn, whose enigmatic power keeps Sanji and Franky from saving her. In St. Saturn's clenched fist, she recalls the memories of her father, Kuma. 47 years ago, Kuma was born to a father of a race on the verge of extinction.
A History Erased! God Valley of Despair

The human hunt begins and the Celestial Dragons start chasing locals of God Valley and slaves for prizes. Ivankov and Ginny share with Kuma and the others their surprising plan to survive the game. Meanwhile, ships full of infamous pirates start arriving on the island one after another.
A Fleeting Moment of Happiness - Kumachi and Ginny

Kuma and Ginny live peacefully in the Sorbet Kingdom eight years after the God Valley Incident. However, their new king initiates a policy of enslaving the poor. Kuma tries to free those who were captured but ends up being imprisoned himself. But a familiar face comes to rescue him.
A Pledge to Ginny - Kuma Becomes a Father
Two years after Ginny’s abduction, the Revolutionary Army suddenly receives a call from her.
To Save His Daughter - Kuma the Timid Pacifist

By fighting off King Bekori who is supported by the World Government, Kuma is put on the wanted list and decides to travel around the world in search of a cure for Bonney's disease. He reunites with Dragon and learns about the Government’s eccentric scientist who might be able to cure Bonney.
Cruel Fate - Kuma`s Decision as a Father

Taking advantage of Kuma’s love for his daughter Bonney, the World Government imposes three harsh conditions on him in exchange for her treatment. Kuma agrees to them and Bonney’s treatment starts at Laboratory 8 in tandem with the clone development with which Kuma agrees to cooperate.
To the Sea Where My Father Is! The Future Bonney Chooses

Bonney has been waiting for a letter from her father Kuma who promised to write to her. But with no letters in sight, she turns nine and one day realizes her disease is cured. She then decides to go out to sea to search for her father.

Bonney sails out to sea in search of her father and rises to prominence. At the same time, Luffy makes his name by defeating the Arlong Pirates and declaring war against the World Government. Watching his actions, Kuma begins to hold a certain belief.
I`m Sorry, Dad - Bonney`s Tears and Kuma`s Fist

The present day on Egghead, Bonney is caught in St. Saturn’s grasp, knowing he is responsible for her father’s transformation into a cyborg. However, Saturn reveals an even more shocking truth that throws Bonney into despair.
Thank You, Dad - Bonney and Kuma`s Warm Embrace

Kuma, battered and without free will, approaches Bonney. Overcome with emotion, she tells him she saw all his memories and learned everything that he did for her. Watching the scene, Vegapunk wonders what compelled Kuma to come to Egghead.
Destroy Egghead - The Buster Call Is Invoked

As an order comes down to evacuate the island in preparation for bombardment, Navy soldiers rush to their ships. Meanwhile, Vegapunk pleads with Saturn to halt the attack, arguing how vital the island is for the future of humanity, but Saturn refuses to listen.
An Admired Hero - The Warrior of Liberation Who Saves Bonney

Vegapunk reveals the secret he alone has been keeping regarding the Pacifistas. Meanwhile, Bonney, her back against the wall, hears a familiar rhythm. It’s the rhythm that her father taught her along with the legend of the hero he admired.
Reliable Reinforcements! Dorry and Brogy Arrive!

The Giant Pirate Crew led by Dorry and Brogy arrive at Egghead, which deeply moves Usopp and the others. Zoro keeps fighting Rob Lucci and the Pacifistas continues to torment the Navy while Luffy shows Bonney how to throw a real punch.

Caribou begs Augur and Devon to let him meet Blackbeard. An order is given to the Navy vice admirals to kill Jewelry Bonney at all costs in order to take back control over the Pacifistas. Sanji flees with the injured Vegapunk while Luffy holds St. Saturn back.
Vegapunk`s Secret Plan - A Tense Worldwide Broadcast

Suddenly, Vegapunk’s broadcast begins and the whole world is taken by surprise. As everyone rushes to set up Video Transponder Snails and screens to watch it, the Five Elders grow concerned and discuss countermeasures.
The Worst Nightmare - The Five Elders Come Together

Just like when St. Saturn emerged on Egghead, black lightning strikes and pentagrams appear again. The Pacifistas are rendered immobile by an unknown shadow. Meanwhile, as the time for the Straw Hats to evacuate the island is drawing near, the fight between Zoro and Lucci intensifies.
Friends Fight Together! Luffy and the Warriors of Elbaph

Dorry and Brogy finally reunite with Luffy. However, they are still facing St. Saturn and St.
Warcury in their alternate forms. Dorry blows a horn to alert his people to prepare to escape, but
St. Warcury unleashes a deafening roar.
An Imminent Threat - Stussy and Edison`s Resolve

Franky and Bonney clash with Navy vice admirals in front of the Elbaph ship. St. Mars tries to find the room from Vegapunk’s broadcast. The heavily injured Stussy tells Kaku the reason she chose to stay behind while Edison takes desperate action to help the Straw Hats escape.
A Stunning Conclusion - Vegapunk`s Great Prediction

Vegapunk’s broadcast resumes as people in various locations all over the world listen closely. St. Mars rushes to find the Transponder Snail that is the source of the broadcast while the Straw Hats and their allies clash with the other members of the Five Elders.
The Lost History - Joyboy, the First Pirate

Vegapunk's revelation sends shockwaves around the world. St. Saturn abandons his fight with Nami and the others and rushes to stop the broadcast at all costs. Vegapunk goes on to expose another stunning truth, this time about Joyboy, the first pirate.
The Void Century - A Revelation About a Sinking World

The severely injured Edison begs Stussy to escape, but she makes a stunning request in exchange. Meanwhile, Vegapunk presents another astonishing disclosure about a past cataclysm and the Ancient Weapons that will fundamentally challenge the beliefs of people everywhere.
Get the Ship Moving! The Iron Giant Activates
Vegapunk’s revelation shocks even Koby and his fellow SWORD members, leading them to discuss what to do next.
Her and Her Father`s Dream! Bonney`s Free Future

Luffy finally hops on the Elbaph ship along with Dorry and Brogy, but the Five Elders catch up to them and begin their assault. Aboard the burning ship, Bonney hears a familiar sound and then finds a new strength in her memories of her father.
Her Father and Mother`s Legacy! Bonney`s Nika Punch

Zoro and the others who are on the Sunny in the Labophase finally attempt to escape, but at the cost of an unexpected sacrifice. Meanwhile, as Vegapunk concludes his speech, Bonney once again faces St. Saturn, the object of her great hatred.
The Upheaval of an Era! The Color of the Supreme King That Leads Luffy

Vegapunk's speech raises the spirits of the pirates across the world, infuriating the Navy and the civilians. However, the broadcast is suddenly cut off while Vegapunk is still speaking. Meanwhile, off the coast of Egghead, the Five Elders are about to deliver the Straw Hats and the Giants a deadly strike.
The Truth Behind the Secret Plan - Vegapunk Claims Victory

Two weeks before the battle erupted on Egghead, Vegapunk found out someone stole a portion of the Mother Flame. Along with Pythagoras and Shaka, he launched an investigation and identified the culprit, also learning their shocking motivation. Then, for the future of humanity, he resolved himself to make a bold decision.
The Promised Horizon - Off to the Long-Awaited Elbaph!

York wakes up to see Island Clouds rising, and to her surprise, something is about to be taken away. Meanwhile, at Mary Geoise, the Celestial Dragons realize their food stock is dwindling and become belligerent. Another one of Vegapunk’s Satellites, Lilith wakes up and receives astonishing news.
The Long-Sought Elbaph! The Big Reunion Banquet!

A reunion banquet with the comrades of the Giant Pirate Crew! They raise their glasses and feast upon giant platters of food. Their destination is the long-awaited Elbaph. Brimming with anticipation for the new adventure, Luffy and his crew surge forward across the vast sea!
Nami in a Fix! An Adventure in Block Kingdom
Nami awakens to find herself in a completely unfamiliar place. Giant creatures attack one after another, driving her into a corner. At that moment, she hears a voice calling her name.
A Quest in the Land of Mystery! The Secret of the Sun God
Luffy and the others come across a warrior riding a grasshopper.
Destroy the Miniature Garden - Escape Block Kingdom!

Pursued by the Sun God, the Straw Hats flee across Block Kingdom at full speed. Amidst the chaos, the Sun God's true objective begins to surface. But as they run, another wall blocks their path. Their breakthrough rests on Luffy’s fists.
An Encounter on a Snowfield - Loki, the Accursed Prince

Leaving the Block Kingdom behind, Luffy and the others find themselves facing a vast snowy landscape and a massive suspension bridge. They resolve to move forward, only to be halted by approaching figures and a mysterious roar.
A Dangerous Deal! Loki of the Underworld and Luffy

Luffy encounters Loki, the Accursed Prince, who offers him a deal. He hints at a connection to Shanks, all while savage beasts crowd around, staring Luffy down. Meanwhile, Zoro and the others on the suspension bridge realize someone is following them.
A Gargantuan Wave of Emotion - The Dreamlike Scenery of Elbaph
Luffy meets up with Gerd and Goldberg. They arrive just after Zoro and Sanji had managed to trap Road. As they explore, Luffy's group reunites with Hajrudin, Dorry, Brogy and the other Straw Hats.
I Want You to Praise Me - The Reunion of Robin and Saul
Robin and the others finally arrive at the port of the Western Village in Elbaph.
Saul`s Resolve - The Inherited Will of Ohara

Robin formally introduces Luffy and the others to Saul. Then his assistant, Ange, shows them around the school, where Usopp is shocked by the education being provided there. Meanwhile, Robin is taken to the library by Saul, where she is met with an incredible sight.
A Welcome with Friends` Cups and Intruders Seeking Loki
Robin, Chopper, Bonney, and Lilith enjoy the Owl Library.
Encountering Loki - Gunko of the Knights of God

As the Straw Hats converse with the Giants, they learn about Nika and Loki. Luffy, Zoro and Nami have Road assist them in the search for Loki's key. Meanwhile, two cryptic individuals approach Loki, seeking an offer.
Shamrock Appears - Commander of the Knights of God

The Straw Hats, Luffy, Nami, and Zoro arrive at the massive Aurust Castle in Elbaf. Meanwhile, Prince Loki is brutally beaten by Gunko for refusing to join the God's Knights, and Figarland Shamrock finally reveals his face.
Ancient History - The Harley Passed Down by Elbaph

Leaving behind a brutal parting gift, Shamrock and Gunko of the Knights of God abandon Loki and move on to their next strategy. Meanwhile, Franky is shown old wall paintings, and Robin reads an important religious text passed down since ancient times in Elbaph.
The Legend Lurking in Elbaph - The Identity of the Mountain-Eater

While exploring the abandoned castle, Luffy and the others find a strange mark on the floor of the throne room and hear a mysterious voice out of nowhere. At the banquet, Oimo tells Usopp the tale of a legendary man linked to the Pirate King.
Get the Key! Luffy vs. Scopper Gaban

Gaban challenges Luffy to try to take the key from him. Luffy goes for it, only to be overpowered by Gaban's sheer force. Meanwhile, Shamrock and Gunko summon reinforcements and plot a detailed strategy to disorient the Giants.
The Heinous Sinner - Loki of the Underworld Freed?!

While observing the Jewel Tree Adam along with Ripley, Franky learns of Elbaph’s weak points. Meanwhile, in the Underworld, Luffy and Zoro find a heavily injured Loki. As they argue over whether to unchain him, an unexpected turn of events blindsides them.
Monsters Appear in Elbaph - "What I Fear Most"

A massive snake suddenly attacks the Walrus School. Saul and the other teachers stand their ground to protect the children, but just then, another mystery strikes, plunging the school into pure panic.
A Nightmarish Game - The Dark Plot of the Knights of God

Saul tries to stop the marching children, but as he reaches out to them, some unknown force gets in his way. Meanwhile, hearing the school’s emergency call throws Dorry and the others at the Western Village into disarray, just as a monster appears before them as well.
Save the Children! The Elbaph Warriors Rise Up
Join Luffy and his crew on thrilling high seas adventures, battling foes and forming unbreakable bonds.
Elbaph in Flames! Jinbe`s Shoulder Throw Explodes!

In the Underworld, Loki talks about a pirate he idolized when he was young. Meanwhile, in the Sun World, the marching children get closer to the fire. The Elbaph Fire Brigade tries to extinguish the flames, while others beg the children to stop. When all hope seems lost, a lone savior arrives to turn the tide.
The Threat of the Arrow-Arrow Fruit - Gunko vs. the Straw Hats

Gunko from the Knights of God shows up right in front of Nami and the others and reveals to them that their plan is to take the children to Mary Geoise. Enraged, the Straw Hats launch an attack, only to be completely overwhelmed by Gunko's extraordinary power.
A Despicable Hostage Game - Sommers`s Brazen Demands

Nami and the others are now captured by Gunko, and Brook receives a demand he never saw coming. Meanwhile, Sommers from the Knights of God begins speaking to all of Elbaph and reveals their true objective.
Protect History and the Future - Robin and Gaban Go on the Attack

One of the marching children, Ronja, is suddenly separated from the group, and Sommers presses Jarul to make an impossible choice. As the Giants bicker over what to do, Robin launches into a reckless move.
One Do-or-Die Second - Gaban vs. the Knights of God
Scopper Gaban, the Pirate King's Left Arm, appears before the captured and immobilized Straw Hats, launching a counteroffensive against the Knights of God. Gunko, however, uncovers his weakness.
Elbaph in Despair - Diabolical Covenant, "Domi Reversi"

Filled with rage, Dorry, Brogy, and their fellow Giants charge at the Knights of God. However, blocked by their dark powers, the Giants are unable to go rescue the children. Nami and the others remain captive, while Luffy and his group are completely unaware in the Underworld. Elbaph is plunged into an absolute crisis.

info.s: Una historia épica de piratas, donde narra la historia de "Monkey D. Luffy" quien cuando tenia 7 años, comió accidentalmente una "Akuma no mi"(Fruta del diablo) la cual le convirtió en un hombre de goma. Por otra parte "Gol D. Roger" conocido como "El rey de los Piratas" quien fuera ejecutado por la Marine, habló antes de morir, acerca de su mayor tesoro,el "One Piece" escondido en la "Gran line". Esta noticia desató la gran era de los piratas lanzando a incontables piratas a ese lugar, en busca del "One Piece" el tesoro perdido. Diez años después, Luffy inspirado en "Gol D. Roger" y un pirata de nombre Akagami no Shanks (Shanks el pelirrojo) se convierte en pirata deseando ser el próximo "Rey de los Piratas" y zarpar para conocer amigos y tener aventuras con ellos, teniendo como meta encontrar el "One Piece".

eps: On her 14th birthday, Akechi Anna encounters the fairy Pochitan wearing a pendant in her room. Anna is then engulfed in the pendant's light and wakes up to find herself...
Mikuru takes Anna to the CUREtto Detective Agency.
Everyone Come to the Curetto Detective Agency!
As black petals flutter and anxiety spreads throughout town, Uta proposes holding a concert and inviting a “special guest.”
The CUREtto Detective Agency gets its first client.

Anna goes to Makoto Mirai Academy, Mikuru’s school, to give Mikuru an umbrella, but then she meets a troubled woman named Mariko who is looking for her little sister Keiko. Meanwhile, Mikuru is asked by the school’s Chairwoman to solve a case involving a ghost in the high school.
Mikuru leaves the care of exhausted Pochitan to Anna and Jett-senpai.
Yikes! The School Is a Maze?
Anna transfers to Mikuru's class at Makoto Mirai Academy. While surprised at the size of the campus, she and Mikuru find themselves lost in a puzzle maze created by Goemon.
Anna and Mikuru convince Jett-senpai to make merchandise from his Pre-Kit inventions and open a store.

A very popular actress, Shiruku Ieiri, comes to Makoto Mirai Academy to film a TV program which has her joining in on a play as a member of the drama club. But right before the performance a very special costume goes missing from the club office.
Solve the Mystery of the Painting!
A client comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency, asking them to help solve a mystery.

A calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild is sent to the Hosho Art Museum. Anna and Mikuru arrive on the scene, there Luluka strikes a conversation with Anna while in the Starlight Princess display room.
The Secret of Cure Arcana Shadow!
Anna and Mikuru set out on a fact-finding mission to learn more about Cure Arcana Shadow.
Anna and the gang chase after Nijee, who has stolen a toy robot. As they face off against the Hanninda, Luluka comes with a message: Maestro Usonoir is on the move.
Anna and Mikuru are on their way to school when Rei, the Student Council President...

In the letter that arrived from London, Anna and the others learn that Cure Arcana Shadow is a genius detective named Luluka Moria. They go to a lake in search of more clues, where they encounter Luluka herself.
Novelist Eliza comes to the CUREtto Detective Agency to ask to work as a detective to get ideas for her next novel. Not long after that, the girls get a request to search for a missing cat.
Anna sees the mother of a client and thinks about her own mother.
While they help set up an exhibition at Hosho Art Museum, a glass slipper on display goes missing. Anna and Mikuru look for clues, certain that it was the work of the Phantom Thieves’ Guild.
Anna and Mikuru are on a school trip, but Goemon appears.

A desperate letter arrives at the CUREtto Detective Agency: “The island could disappear!” Leading Anna and Mikuru to take a boat to the isolated island. To solve the case, they must unravel the secret behind an old island song.
Eriza Kurusu appears before Anna and Mikuru and tell thems, “I want to join the CUREtto Detective Agency!”

Shiruku Ieiri invites Anna and Mikuru to her show, and when they come to her dressing room, she shows them a calling card that was left by the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. As they search the theater before the performance, Anna spots Luluka.
Together with Rei, Anna and Mikuru investigate some mysterious incidents happening at Makoto Mirai Academy. As they check the science room, music room, and art room, Rei notices a pattern.
The perfume Jett-senpai has been making is finally ready. Then, a new calling card arrives from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild. Cure Eclair’s identity will finally be revealed!

Kurea’s memory has been restored by the Top of Lily fragrance. Shushutan also reveals herself in front of everyone. Meanwhile, Usonoir, who has misused the power of the Makoto Jewel, loses control and goes on a rampage.

With her memory restored, Kurea confesses to Anna and Mikuru that she was never a detective. As they reel from this news, the owner of a restaurant enters with a request for them to search for her missing cook.

Paul, an exchange student from London, receives a calling card from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild and runs to the CUREtto Detective Agency for help. The calling card looks very flashy, and the listed time is down to the second, making it different from previous cards.
Decchi Agein and Goemon replay Kurea’s world of memories. There, Anna and the gang witness Kurea and Luluka’s first meeting at the London CUREtto Detective Agency three years earlier.

During the summer holidays, Anna and the others go to Makoto Mirai Academy to help student council president Rei care for the flower beds. While working, they realize that the zinnias that were blooming just minutes earlier have all been cut.

Cure Answer and the others have their transformations dissolved by the sheer power of Eclipse Shadow. As Cure Eclair’s secrets and Luluka’s true intentions are revealed, Anna and Mikuru transform into Precures again and extend their hands to Kurea.

With nowhere to go, Luluka spends her days at Pâtisserie ChuChu. While she’s there, a customer’s lost item containing a Makoto Jewel is stolen. Anna and the others deduce that the culprit must be among three customers on the terrace and prepare to question them, but Luluka intervenes.
The Path to Star Detective Starts with a Single Step

Just as Luluka is settling into the CUREtto Detective Agency, Goemon barges in. Unable to accept her departure from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild, he generates a trick maze to test her skills. Countless doors appear, all leading to other worlds, and who appears from behind those doors...?
Luluka and the Gold-Star Full Moon

Anna and the others recover a wooden box that was stolen by the Phantom Thieves’ Guild and take it to the police for help with finding the owner. Shiruku Ieiri is there as Police Chief for a day, and helps put out a call for the owner, but three people arrive, all claiming to own the item.

Kurea and Luluka begin attending high school at Minato Mirai Academy. Their new classmates try striking up a conversation with Luluka but she’s unable to respond well. Just then, she notices a love letter on the floor of the classroom.

Anna and the others enter a bookstore in the shopping arcade in pursuit of a Makoto Jewel. As they work to deduce the whereabouts of the shopkeeper’s stolen gold medal, a conversation with a high school girl named Haruna Makifusa, who happened to stop by, provides them with a valuable hint.

Usonoir and Nijee steal Makopyon, a mascot suit for the shopping arcade with a Makoto Jewel inside, and run away from Anna and the others. Then, they disguise themselves as customers and duck into Patisserie ChuChu to wait until the heat is off.

Anna, Mikuru, and Luluka head out for the day, leaving Kurea at the quiet CUREtto Detective Agency to ruminate about why she has the power of the Forgotten Race. Then, a client comes in with a calling card she got from the Phantom Thieves’ Guild.

info.s: SERIE EN VERSION ORIGINAL- Anna Akechi, una chica de 14 años que viaja en el tiempo desde 2027 hasta 1999, donde conoce a Mikuru Kobayashi. Juntas se transforman en detectives mágicas para proteger sonrisas, resolver misterios y enfrentar a los Ladrones Fantasma mientras buscan la forma de devolver a Anna a su época.

eps: Despite a few heart-fluttering encounters, Taiki doubts his crush Chinatsu even knows his name. Later, shocking news forces him to make a bold move.
You Have to Go to Nationals
Taiki's new housemate quickly makes herself at home. As they grow closer, his attempts to keep the situation a secret cause a misunderstanding.
Taiki overhears Haryu calling Chinatsu by a special nickname and gets flustered. Will it affect his upcoming match against the upperclassman?
A gym uniform mix-up leads to a heart-pounding exchange. Later, Haryu raises the stakes for Taiki’s match, while Kyo makes a secret request to Chinatsu.
With both players going neck and neck on the court, will Taiki win his match against Kishi — and will Chinatsu invite him to the aquarium?
On her way to return Chinatsu's mobile phone, Hina makes a shocking discovery. The gymnast faces mounting pressure while struggling with her new feelings.
Chinatsu overhears rival players speak poorly about her recent game. Later, Hina playfully steals a bite from Taiki — and Chinatsu notices from afar.
As Taiki strives to make it to the nationals, Chinatsu gives him a word of encouragement. Later, Haryu and Taiki face top players in the doubles match.
Frustrated with his loss to Sajikawa High, Taiki overworks himself studying for midterms and falls ill, when Chinatsu suddenly appears in his room.
After a sleepless night, Taiki asks Haryu for relationship advice. Later, Chinatsu realizes her recent behavior might hinder her dream and trouble others.
With the annual fireworks festival approaching, Hina musters the courage to invite Taiki, who's been avoiding Chinatsu since their awkward conversation.
Taiki attends the fireworks festival with Hina and is surprised by her new look and shyness. Later, he unexpectedly bumps into Chinatsu with a lost child.
Taiki worries about a potential misunderstanding after Chinatsu departs. At the badminton nationals, he learns more about Karen and Haryu's relationship.
While Chinatsu faces immense pressure at the nationals, Hina cheers up a worried Taiki with a game where the loser shares an embarrassing secret.
Despite it being her birthday, Chinatsu still seems a little down. Taiki takes her somewhere special — but the weather might have other plans.
As a new school term begins, the school buzzes with preparations for the upcoming festival. Chinatsu reflects on her restless feelings towards Taiki.
Of Course I Want to See It
Upon learning of an upcoming practice match with Sajikawa High, Taiki worries about facing Yusa gain. Chinatsu and Hina promise their support.
Sajikawa High arrives for the much-anticipated practice match. As Chinatsu watches from the sidelines, she thinks about how far Taiki has come.
Just before the school festival starts, Taiki goes for his usual morning jog and finds Chinatsu practicing nearby. She extends a surprising invitation.
As One of Her Closest Friends
After a blissful time with Chinatsu, Nishida's ominous fortune comes true! His classmate playing the prince can't perform, so Taiki must take on the role.
While rumors swirl around Taiki and Hina, Chinatsu seems unfazed. However, while spending the night at Karen's, the basketballer shares her true thoughts.
After learning about Hina's unrequited feelings for Taiki, Ayame decides to help — and the perfect chance arises at the upcoming autumn training camp!
An exciting card game with friends leaves Taiki's head spinning. He mulls over his feelings for Chinatsu and Hina as the training camp continues.
Hina experiences a roller coaster of emotions over her affection for Taiki and, thanks to Ayame, gets a chance to be alone with him on the last night.
Ayame faces the consequences of her meddling and tries all sorts of ways to console Hina. Meanwhile, Taiki strengthens his resolve and asks Chinatsu out.

info.s: Taiki, que juega a bádminton, siempre ha admirado a la estrella del baloncesto Chinatsu desde la distancia. Pero un día de primavera, un giro inesperado une sus caminos.

eps: Once the city's strongest assassin, Nagi Taira is left unresponsive after protecting his younger sister, Shizuka, and now lives in a wheelchair. Working as an assassin broker, Shizuka takes on assassination jobs and brings her brother to the battlefield for his "rehab." Hoping to fully awaken Nagi, Shizuka accepts a contract to take out Goro Arashiyama, the boss of a notorious robbery gang.

For Nagi's rehabilitation, Shizuka searches for someone with an even stronger killing intent and sets her sights on Ryo Takanashi, a highly skilled sniper. Takanashi is a deranged man interested only in "good targets." Shizuka asks him to shoot Nagi, hoping his intense killing intent will fully awaken her brother.

Naozumi Kurosaka and his younger sister Touko, students at the assassin-training institution "the Academy" Nagi and Shizuka once attended, arrive on Guicheng Island in pursuit of them. Members of Class A, they suspect Nagi is behind the spate of strange killings on the island. When Shizuka runs into them, they grill her about Nagi's whereabouts, and she finds herself in grave danger.

The Kurosaka siblings track down Nagi and Shizuka, leaving them cornered. Determined to use even this situation as part of Nagi's rehabilitation, Shizuka provokes Touko, triggering a fierce battle between Nagi and her. Nagi fights in his Tank Chair Mark III: "Iron Fists" but is soon forced into a tough battle when Naozumi joins the fray.

info.s: Nagi Taira era el asesino más fuerte hasta que cayó en coma protegiendo a su hermana menor de una bala. Sin embargo, su constitución física única le permite recuperar la conciencia por un corto tiempo cuando la "intención de matar" se dirige hacia él. ¡Ahora comienza la "rehabilitación" de Nagi! ¡Luchará contra objetivos poderosos en su silla de ruedas personalizada hasta que logre un despertar completo!

eps: Ashito finally gets the promotion to the A team, and he does everything he can to keep up. However...
When Taira and Matsunaga invite Ashito and the others to dinner, Kuribayashi appears and joins them.
Ashito makes the A team's roster for the Premier League for the match against Kashiwa Dai Business School.
Ashito fails to keep up with the pace of the Premier League, and Kashiwa identifies him as a weak spot.

info.s: Aoi Ashito es un estudiante de tercer año de secundaria de Ehime. Detrás de su juego rudo se esconde su inmenso talento, pero Ashito sufre un gran revés debido a su personalidad demasiado sencilla. El director del equipo juvenil del club J1 Tokyo City Esperion, Fukuda Tetsuya, aparece frente a Ashito. Fukuda ve el potencial ilimitado de Ashito y lo invita a participar en las pruebas de su equipo en Tokio.

eps: A teenaged hired killer stays at Hotel Inhumans while infiltrating a high school for a job.
A teenaged hired killer learns about what it takes to play piano and what it takes to be a friend.
There’s a new arrival at Hotel Inhumans, and a treasured companion goes missing.
Time is running out to find a treasured companion, and a first time guest makes a last minute booking.

info.s: Los mejores hoteles deben cumplir ciertas normas, como ofrecer la mejor gastronomía, opciones para relajarse y un buen entretenimiento. Obviamente, también necesitan contar con la mejor selección de armas, formas eficaces de falsificar identidades y medios para deshacerse de cualquier prueba. En este hotel en la frontera de la muerte trabajan dos conserjes, Ikuro Hoshi y Sara Haizaki. ¿Qué les pedirán los asesinos?

Un día, de camino a casa después de la escuela, Noriko se ve inmersa inesperadamente en un extraño y extraordinario mundo de fantasía. Sus problemas se multiplican exponencialmente cuando un apuesto joven llamado Izark la rescata y entabla amistad con ella. Aunque valiente y audaz, en su interior acecha la maldad más oscura imaginable. Y según una antigua profecía, Noriko posee el poder de desatar ese mal. Ahora, unidos inexorablemente, estos dos improbables aliados deberán navegar por un mundo a la vez maravilloso y hostil.

eps: The Dark Summoner and the Stubborn Priest
Amora and Roni have no business hooking up. They do anyway.
The Dark Summoner Is Trapped in a Room
Amona and Roni are trapped in a room. The Imp adds a bed.
The Dark Summoner and the Phantom S*men Thief
A Phantom Thief intends to steal the treasure from Roni's little Roni!
The Dark Summoner and the Orc Nest
Roni rises to the occasion when Amona is captured by orcs.

info.s: ¡Amona, una oscura invocadora y chica semihumana que es demasiado débil para resistir sus deseos, y Roni, un sacerdote demasiado serio! Roni da la bienvenida a Aruni como nuevo miembro de su grupo de aventuras. Todos esperaban que los dos chocaran y se convirtieran en enemigos jurados. Pero, para su sorpresa y en su primer día juntos, ¡tienen una aventura de una noche...!

eps: Takeru's new girlfriend, Kaori, suggests they go on a karaoke date. Takeru is stumped by this unexpected request, especially since he's terrible at singing. While at a loss for words, Kaori's friend Tomoko, who just happened to be there, says she wants to join them, and the three of them end up going together.

After karaoke, Takeru and Kaori hold hands as they walk home, going with the flow. Kaori is thrilled that it's their first time, but Takeru is distracted, recalling his earlier interaction with Tomoko. Ignoring Takeru's distracted state, Kaori asks for a kiss and, carried away by the moment, leans in toward him.

As a sign of reconciliation, Kaori goes to Takeru's apartment. Takeru warmly encourages her while she smiles and does her best at cooking, something she's not good at. Then, Kaori, unable to hold back her emotions, throws her arms around him. Thinking that she put him off again, Kaori tries to leave, but Takeru pulls her back and kisses her.

Takeru jolts awake as the flashbacks of his encounter with Tomoko, which seemed to erase his promise to Kaori, flood his mind. When he sits up, his gaze falls on Tomoko, with whom he spent the night, as she prepares breakfast with practiced ease.

info.s: La historia de Takeru Hidaka, un ambicioso estudiante de secundaria que aspira a estudiar medicina y que acaba de empezar a salir con su primera novia, Kaori Koga. Aunque la relación entre Takeru y Kaori parece perfecta y armoniosa ante los demás, la paz se rompe cuando la mejor amiga de Kaori, Tomoko Yoshioka, comienza a seducir y coquetear abiertamente con Takeru. Atrapado entre la lealtad hacia su novia y las tentadoras insinuaciones de Tomoko, Takeru cae en una compleja red de mentiras y secretos. Esta situación pone en grave peligro tanto su futuro académico como sus sentimientos y estabilidad emocional, con el miedo constante de que su secreto sea descubierto.
